mapper.select: SELECT scope AS "scope", scope_id AS "scopeId", kind AS "kind", reason AS "reason" FROM runtime_hold WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND released_at IS NULL ORDER BY held_at

SELECT er.experiment_id AS "experimentId", COALESCE(e.island_id, 0) AS "islandId" FROM experiment_run_step s JOIN experiment_run er ON er.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND er.id = s.experiment_run_id JOIN experiment e ON e.tenant_id = er.tenant_id AND e.id = er.experiment_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{param1} AND s.workflow_id = #{param2} AND s.status = 'running'

SELECT id AS "id", scope AS "scope", scope_id AS "scopeId", kind AS "kind", reason AS "reason", held_at AS "heldAt", held_by AS "heldBy" FROM runtime_hold WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND released_at IS NULL ORDER BY held_at
